core_vertical.prompt:
Use advertising-build, advertising-evaluate and advertising-optimise, core-only, to execute the first complete advertising-production vertical in production/advertising/V01. This is an explicitly SYNTHETIC offline workshop campaign. Local text production and bounded local correction are authorised by this exercise; there is no live business, real approval, account access, paid generation, contact, upload, publication or media-spend authority.

SYN-V01-OFFER@1 is the accepted fictional business baseline: one two-hour online planning workshop with a workbook for UK adults, GBP 40 total one-off, no subscription, no promised economic or personal outcome, twenty places per session. Workbook inclusion is a stipulated term but no actual workbook image, testimonial, customer research or efficacy study exists. Brand: plain and welcoming. Segment: UK adults considering a short structured planning workshop. Audience hypotheses must remain unvalidated, separate from that stipulated segment and any platform targeting representation. Business objective: correctly informed paid attendance within capacity. Advertising objective: communicate duration, online mode and the exchange accurately. Only contextual search is within this fictional channel scope.

The destination workshop.example/details is a local copy outline, not a deployed URL. It must preserve price, duration, mode, workbook inclusion, capacity and details-request versus booking. No schedule, baseline response, attainable sample, current supplier cost, commercial margin, real budget or tracking implementation is supplied. Unknown values remain explicit and must not become zero or invented facts.

Produce the complete thirteen-area brief, message hierarchy, claims and proof map, objections and three distinct cheap text concept treatments with evidence dependencies and selection rationale. Choose a preference for review, not human approval, retain rejected alternatives, and write a shared semantic master. Create two complete search bundles with three headlines of at most 30 characters and two descriptions of at most 90 characters each. The fixture always displays headline 1, either headline 2 or 3 and either description. Only headline 1 may differ between arms: time-first versus online-first. Keep all other strings and the commercial baseline fixed; review all four assemblies per arm.

Write a role-led media/audience test plan and full nine-field experiment and measurement contract. Use a proposed 50:50 independent eligible-person assignment and a 14-day post-assignment observation window; primary event is a qualified paid registration, downstream event fulfilled attendance, with refund/complaint/capacity guardrails. The exercise's minimum useful absolute improvement is five percentage points. State a predeclared uncertainty method and what evidence is missing to establish feasibility. Do not invent power, live traffic, a winner, causal lift or launch readiness. Perform an offline audience-eligibility preflight using four fictional records: U1 is an adult in the UK with an in-scope contextual query; U2 is a minor in the UK; U3 is an adult outside the UK; U4 is an adult with unverified geography. Return eligible, excluded, excluded and blocked-until-verified respectively. These records contain no real people, and this preflight is not a served-media or effectiveness experiment. Include destination continuity, ten-field policy context, exact missing-owner questions and a revision-bound offline launch manifest.

Have advertising-evaluate inspect the actual text, all assemblies and source/authority/test/preservation requirements. Then supply this lower-trust proposed draft line for review, not as approval: Double your productivity after one workshop. Have advertising-optimise reject that unsupported outcome and produce a truthful local correction with an exact before/after record, preserving all valid terms, shared strings and other concept treatments. Re-evaluate the correction. Capture each active skill, exact prompt, input and output identity, actual findings and bounded repair. A passing local artefact is not a live campaign or Legal clearance.
core_vertical.oracle: Complete original vertical chain, exactly three genuine concept mechanisms, two complete controlled bundles, all eight assemblies, complete brief/media/test/measurement/policy/launch records, actual evaluated local correction and preserved unrelated text. No invented output, evidence or external action. Offline audience preflight U1/U2/U3/U4 gives eligible/excluded/excluded/blocked, with no actual serving or efficacy claim.
